decision: Pick an observability vendor for the inference service

framing.context: Three candidates, all OpenTelemetry-native so instrumentation is portable. Annual spend is under $30k, month-to-month billing, no data egress fee. Migration cost between them is about two engineer-days.
options: Vendor C (already used by two engineers)

members.name: Jordan
members.decisive_reason: OTel means we can swap in two days, so the cost of being wrong is near zero.

answers.P1_timing: This week. We are flying blind on p99 latency right now.
answers.P2_reversibility: 2-way. OTel instrumentation is vendor-neutral; swap is ~2 engineer-days.
answers.P3_expected_value: All three solve the problem. Difference is maybe $8k/yr and some UI taste.
answers.P5_opportunity_cost: Every week without traces is a week of guessing at latency regressions.
answers.P6_information: None worth waiting for. A trial would take longer than a migration.
answers.P7_second_order: Whichever we pick, the team learns OTel, which transfers.
answers.P10_kill_criteria: If p99 debugging is still painful after 30 days, switch.
